scenario.description: RX channel goes silent (no SYNC) for >= 256 cycles. Receiver must escalate to RESTRAINT_HOLD and recover when SYNC returns.

timeline_cycles.event: last valid SYNC observed on w_rx
watchdog fires: emit RESTRAINT_HOLD upstream, write RX_STUCK audit row
SYNC re-asserts on w_rx; receiver clears watchdog and resumes IDLE

retry_policy.applies_to: downstream re-emission of any frame that the upstream side acknowledges was lost

honesty.note: Current d2d_holo_mesh.v stub does not implement the watchdog. The expected behaviour above is SPEC-DRAFT until a sim/ testbench under sim/tb_d2d_*.v exercises it.
